lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: What did he start it with?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: Wh-wh-what do you mean, before you got there? You carry her out, is the fire burning already when you carried her out?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: So you throw her on top of the fire?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: This fire is going when you go knock on the door?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: That’s what you mean by before you got there?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: Does he say why the fire’s burning?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: So, you when you carried her out of the house, and you put ‘er by the garage, and Steve shoots her, then you put her on top of the fire that’s already going?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: OK, and then what do you do from there, go ahead.
